5.title: P0: Rebuild poster around adversarial evidence handoff, not protocol internals
5.body:
## Why
The current poster is technically rigorous but visually dominated by CBOR/Merkle/trace implementation detail. The Berlin room already contains work on EO agents, provenance, validation and guardrails.

## Required change
Make the central scientific story:

**Agents should hand over evidence references, not paraphrases of evidence.**

Lead with:
1. a concrete agent failure;
2. the controlled intervention;
3. measured false-acceptance / false-rejection results;
4. the minimal cryptographic mechanism explaining the result.

## Must remain explicit
- cryptographic integrity is not scientific truth;
- upstream correctness is not automatically guaranteed;
- entity identity is not fully solved;
- EMEM is complementary to guardrails, RAG and EO agents.

## Poster edits
- Reduce implementation detail by ~40%.
- Keep one invariant: bytes -> BLAKE3 -> CID.
- Keep one verification path: resolve -> re-hash -> compare.
- Make the mutation table the visual focal point.
- Put detailed 15-link traces behind the QR.

Reference: research/should_do/10_EVENT_FIELD_MAP_AND_CRITIQUE.md

6.title: P1: Build adversarial evidence-handoff benchmark for EMEM
6.body:
## Goal
Measure whether EMEM actually prevents agent evidence errors rather than only proving its cryptographic invariants.

## Experimental conditions
A. prose
B. structured raw value
C. ordinary retrieval/RAG
D. EMEM token

## Mutations
- value ±1 ULP
- rounding
- wrong cell / adjacent cell
- wrong date / stale value
- swapped band
- changed unit
- changed source
- changed derivation parameter
- changed model checkpoint / embedding
- same value, different entity
- altered token payload
- valid old token presented as current

## Models / runtimes
Use 4–6 materially different models and at least MCP plus one non-MCP/direct tool path where practical.

## Metrics
- false acceptance rate
- false rejection rate
- mutation detection rate
- verification completion
- decision accuracy
- latency
- LLM-token overhead

Report n and confidence intervals for every headline result.

The key result should be a controlled comparison of whether an agent accepts invalid evidence.

Reference: research/should_do/10_EVENT_FIELD_MAP_AND_CRITIQUE.md
